entries.reason_it_cannot_pass: Two irreducible causes. (a) The frozen INPUT_FREEZE.json (created 2026-09-14) lists two _smoke NPZ files that no longer exist on disk: experiments/dynamic_fusion/unified_fusion_paper_support_20260913/_smoke/units/mpdd_s0_k2/bracket_black/{evaluation_scores,patch_scores}.npz. They were never committed to git (.gitignore ignores *.npz) and a four-way search (git history, this disk, the mirror worktree, the release/replication packages and the external disk) found no copy, so the size+mtime integrity loop records them as 'missing'. (b) experiments/dynamic_fusion/unified_fusion_paper_support_20260913/REPORT_CN.md has an unchanged size (10029 B) and an identical sha256 to the frozen value, but its mtime drifted by ~760387.8 s, which the same size+mtime criterion flags. Neither cause can be cleared without editing data or faking timestamps, which this revision is forbidden to do.
entries.impact: None on any manuscript number, figure or text. The _smoke tree is a smoke-test fixture that is explicitly not a result (docs/ARTIFACT_INDEX.md:131-133: its figures must not be cited); the real result trees (p1_matrix, p4_fullpixel, EXT, NEW) are intact and on disk; no paper table/figure/statistics script reads the missing _smoke NPZ; and REPORT_CN.md's content bytes are unchanged (sha256 identical to the frozen value), so only its timestamp moved. The only substantive effect is that this check must keep failing on re-run, which is exactly why it is registered as an exemption.
